Toy Conflict is a strategic battle simulation fighting game. The game encompasses two main modes: Campaign and Sandbox.

In campaign, you are given a limited amount of in-game resources to build an army to defeat an enemy force. To win the game you need to analyze the battlefield and come up with your strategy, play wisely by  selecting the right types of toys and place them at the right positions on the map. You will learn and develop your strategies. 

In sandbox, you build both armies and the two opposing armies can be placed on either side of the map. Once you tap the play button, the battle starts and the two armies rush forward to attack each other. When either army has been defeated, the battle stop and you are informed of who the victor is.
